tools.description: POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/execution-summaries. Task status changes require an execution summary, including close_activity using the same atomic service. statusObserved is a server-owned historical snapshot. Every new summary requires usageReport.entries with measured cumulative_snapshot session/session_tree usage, identified modelId and actor.kind=agent with persisted UUIDv7. Supply non-null decimal-string totalTokens equal to inclusive inputTokens + outputTokens; never add cached input or reasoning output again. The total is the source session/epoch/model/actor accumulation through observedAt, not task-exclusive consumption or a required delta. A first real snapshot is accepted as a baseline with previousEvidenceId null and delta null. Subsequent comparable snapshots reference the latest evidenceId; preserve reset/gap baselines honestly. Repeated evidence keeps its identity and is not counted twice. Keep multiple disjoint sessions/models separate; do not sum cumulative checkpoints or overlapping tree and child totals, or label mixed-model totals with the last selected model. Collect actual session counters from permitted Codex App Server/exec streams, Copilot SDK/CLI/VS Code telemetry, Claude SDK/OTel, or authorized Cursor usage exports; check surface/version and documented counter semantics. Kiro credits/context are not token measurements. No unavailable, estimated, model null, missing total or fabricated zero can substitute in a new summary. If collection fails, record the impediment in a comment without changing status or claiming a saved summary. Legacy reads, late-evidence schemas and exact saved idempotent replays remain compatible.. tools.description: Atomically record optional block/comment and cumulative execution.currentSummary and historical execution summary, deliverables, pending work, status and optional review. Kiro credits/context do not establish tokens. No unavailable, estimated, null model or fabricated zero for new summaries; use a comment to report collection failure. Position.description: Before deve ser irmão na mesma coluna. RecordExecution.description: Completed exige status final e sem bloqueio, define progresso 100. Outros outcomes exigem status não final; blocked exige bloqueio existente. RecordedSessionUsage.description: Stored canonical deltas from cumulative session checkpoints, irrespective of task attribution. Not an additional task total; never add to knownTotalTokens. Baselines and duplicate references contribute no tokens; missing totals remain null. Sessions count distinct source/sessionId pairs. Excludes request and session_tree scopes. Totals are decimal strings, computed across all pages with up to 128-bit precision.
